blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: SIMT — Single instruction, multiple threads execution model.
divergence — Threads follow differing control paths.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: GPUs provide many execution units designed for high-throughput parallel operations on large batches of data.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Besides graphics, GPUs can accelerate machine learning, physical simulations, image processing and some scientific calculations.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Transfers between memory/device, limited parallelism and divergent branching can outweigh GPU speedup on small or sequential tasks.

blocks.title: Worked example · Follow the reasoning
